permit.applies: The hosting party is responsible for the applicant, such as the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Youth or a recognised educational body; the Royal Oman Police issues the visa.
permit.first: A host in Oman (the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Youth or a recognised body) for the cultural activity; the visa must be activated within three months of issue.

fees.what: Cultural visa, per year of validity

permit.eligibility: "Foreign citizens engaging in culture-focused activity can now access this visa."

sources.title: Gulf News, Oman unveils cultural visa to attract global talent (November 2025)
sources.said: has announced the introduction of a cultural visa scheme, with the aim of providing clear legal avenues for foreign nationals to reside and work temporarily within its borders in the fields of arts and culture. … Foreign citizens engaging in culture-focused activity can now access this visa. … The visa is available with one, five, or ten-year durations, each subject to an annual fee of 50 Omani rials. … The Royal Oman Police, alongside relevant agencies, stipulate that the visa must be activated within a three-month window from the date of issue … Responsibility for applicants lies with the hosting party—such as the Ministry of Culture, Sports, and Youth, or recognised educational bodies

blockers.sought: The Royal Oman Police's own decision or page on the cultural visa (the facts above rest on a newspaper's report)
